title: A scaled restriction of a locally finite measure to Ω × G is a varifold on Ω
statement: Let Ω ⊆ ℝ^N be open, μ a measure on ℝ^N × G(N,n), and c ∈ [0,∞] with c ≠ ∞. Assume μ(K × G(N,n)) ≠ ∞ for every compact K ⊆ Ω. Then there is an n-varifold W on Ω (W : Varifold N n Ω) whose measure is W.measure = c • μ⌞(Ω × G(N,n)).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (Ω : Set (Euclidean N)) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n)) (c : ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen Ω → c ≠ ∞ → (∀ K : Set (Euclidean N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ Ω → μ (K ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) ≠ ∞) → ∃ W : Varifold N n Ω, W.measure = c • μ.restrict (Ω ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)))
